pillars.review: crosscheck passage in context, book structure and historical setting; use multiple sources
separate cited claims, contextual interpretation and contemporary pastoral application; no quotation misattribution
Christ-centered broad positioning without sectarian certainty or invented revelation
no divine deadlines, miracle promises, intimidation, false clinical/financial assurances
new wording, no intentional verbatim copied translation/commentary and a separate anti-duplication gate
clear compelling opening, escalating argument, logical progression, resolution and honest non-clickbait loop
clear pt-BR, natural speech, no unreadable abbreviations and measured duration required after TTS
dated URLs/source attestations and SHA256 of exact script; URLs are not copyright licenses
each visual depicts appropriate narrative, no unlicensed imagery, no repeats after crops/edits
source, rights, intelligibility, loudness, mix and faithful voice profile
temporal sync, safe area, format, fps, resolution and actual decoded master
accurate titles, covers, descriptions, platform rules, source credits, rights and release status

limits: The existing ChatGPT conversation can produce evidence-based semantic review and version it, but GitHub Actions alone has no live LLM service configured.
GitHub Models inference API was retired 2026-07-30 and is forbidden as a new dependency.
A static JSON receipt does not mean a CI job ran independent LLM inference; CI checks provenance, schema and alignment.
Future episodes require their own actual semantic assessment by an available model before internal approval; no silent blanket pass.
Rights, media render, video QA and publication always require their own independent evidence and gates.
The owner does not need to review or sign off the finished video after all physical, rights and creative gates pass. Publishing or external distribution remains a separate explicit user action.
